paths.message: chezy bans useEffect. Use the 5 patterns from .agents/skills/no-use-effect/SKILL.md or the useMountEffect escape hatch (import { useMountEffect } from '@chezy/ui/hooks/useMountEffect').

patterns.message: Use the `~/*` alias (tsconfig paths). Imports starting with `~/` are forbidden outside chezy-owned packages and apps/web (which owns the alias).
chezy uses the `~/*` alias (tsconfig paths), not the upstream `@/*`.
Server-only persistence. Reach the server via a Route Handler / Server Action; do not value-import from client components.

no-restricted-properties.message: Inject config through packages/config (Valibot env parser). Direct process.env reads are banned outside packages/config and *.config-bound.ts files.
Import `env` from `~/lib/env`. In apps/web only NEXT_PUBLIC_* (build-time inlined) and NODE_ENV reads are allowed; config-bound files are exempt via the scoped override below.
